title: Constant-section geometric coordinates and localized inverse-image composition
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and a Base b as in [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. On every scheme morphism f there exists Geometry g_f in b's fixed source and target calculi. There are ordinary inverse-image composition isomorphisms c_(f,g):g_g.pull followed by g_f.pull is isomorphic to g_(f composed with g).pull. The exact cochain localization of c evaluates to the composite of the two specified pullEvaluation maps and the canonical constant-ring derived pullback composition isomorphism at every positive ell-power quotient. This statement does not provide open extension, open tensor comparison or a Base.

proof.text: Construct the geometric semilinear system calculus using the given source calculus. The constant-section inverse-image ring comparisons identify the coefficient sheaves and all quotient transitions with the actual source-scheme coefficients. Transport the full level inverse-image/direct-image/adjunction package together, with the identity-on-sections normalization. Use the fixed target calculus and transport its signed K-flat models by their canonical comparisons. This gives Geometry, its fixed target-calculus equality and its transition and projection equations.

Form ordinary inverse-image composition by adjunction conjugacy from the sectionwise direct-image compositor. Both its finite evaluation and the canonical finite pullback compositor are transposes of the same constant-section map, hence agree before localization. Localize the exact cochain functors and this ordinary square. Use the geometric pullEvaluation_model equation and the canonical finite composition normalization, and extend from Q(P) to arbitrary derived objects by naturality. This supplies the displayed evaluation equation of the termwise localized ordinaryComp.

lean.statement:
theorem strictGeometricCoordinates (b : Base l E) :
    ∃ geometry : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), Geometry l E b f,
      ∃ ordinaryComp : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
        (geometry g).pull ⋙ (geometry f).pull ≅ (geometry (f ≫ g)).pull,
      ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (n : ℕ) (K : D l E Z),
        (Ev l E X n).map
            (((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso (geometry g).pull (geometry f).pull).symm ≪≫
              Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (ordinaryComp f g)).hom.app K) ≫
            ((geometry (f ≫ g)).pullEvaluation n).hom.app K =
          ((geometry f).pullEvaluation n).hom.app ((pull l E b (geometry g)).obj K) ≫
            (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback (R l E n) f).map
              (((geometry g).pullEvaluation n).hom.app K) ≫
            (proEtaleConstantRingPullbackComposition f g (R l E n)).hom.app
              ((Ev l E Z n).obj K)
